title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL: RLHF for a Diffusion Model
hook: Qwen's team applied RLHF and on-policy distillation to a text-to-image diffusion model — the same post-training playbook that shaped chat models, now tuning image generation and editing.
key_points: Builds task-specific reward models via fine-tuned VLMs with chain-of-thought scoring — alignment, aesthetics, and portrait fidelity for generation; instruction-following and identity preservation for editing.
Trains with a GRPO-based RL framework, including guidance tricks to preserve pretrained knowledge and per-category reward calibration.
Merges separately-trained generation and editing policies into one model via on-policy distillation with trajectory-level velocity matching.
Reports consistent gains: +2.61 on Qwen-Image-Bench, plus higher Elo in both text-to-image and image-edit arenas.
content_html: RLHF reshaped chat models by scoring outputs against learned preferences instead of raw next-token likelihood. Qwen-Image-2.0-RL brings that same idea to image generation and editing.
extra_html: The pipeline builds task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning vision-language models with pointwise scoring and chain-of-thought reasoning — covering alignment, aesthetics, and portrait fidelity for text-to-image generation, and instruction-following accuracy plus face-identity preservation for editing. On top of that reward system, the team runs a scalable GRPO-based RL framework with a hybrid classifier-free-guidance strategy to preserve pretrained knowledge, prompt curation via reward-range filtering, and per-category reward weight calibration. To merge the separately trained generation and editing policies into one deployable model, they use on-policy distillation as a final stage, consolidating multiple teachers through trajectory-level velocity matching. The result: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL gains 2.61 points on Qwen-Image-Bench over the base model, plus Elo gains of 78 and 93 points in the text-to-image and image-edit arenas respectively — consistent improvements in aesthetics, prompt adherence, and editing accuracy. Yixian Xu and colleagues, arXiv 2026.

related.title: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
related.hook: RLHF works but is fiddly: a separate reward model and a finicky RL loop. DPO reaches the same goal with one simple loss — and became a popular default.

related.title: GRPO: Group Relative Policy Optimization
related.hook: GRPO dropped the value network from PPO and scored each answer against a group of sampled siblings — the cheap RL recipe that made DeepSeek-R1's reasoning trainable.

related.title: Nano Banana (Gemini Image)
related.hook: Google's native Gemini image model — nicknamed Nano Banana — made conversational, character-consistent image editing go viral, drawing millions to the Gemini app.

flashcards.back_html: Reinforcement learning from fine-tuned reward models (via GRPO), followed by on-policy distillation to merge specialized policies into one deployable model.
